summary: Volato Group, Inc. filed an 8-K regarding Share Exchange Agreements dated April 16-17, 2026, to acquire 48,044,912 shares of M2i Global, Inc. common stock (traded OTC: MTWO) from three investors, including Charcoal Hill Family LP, Douglas Cole, and Clearthink Capital Partners LLC. Issuance: 5,407,499 shares of Volato Class A common stock to the investors. Implied values: $0.0304 per M2i share, $0.2701 per Volato share. Shares are unregistered but Volato will file a resale registration statement within 60 days. The exchange is structured as a private placement under Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation D. Watch for regulatory clearance and integration risks; arbitrage hinges on Volato's stock retaining implied value post-deal.
